meta.name: OSU Dispenser Installation — Logistics & Planning Hub
meta.campus: The Ohio State University — Columbus Campus
meta.summary: Campus-wide dispenser rollout across 262 buildings, organized by physical quadrant first and department second to maximize daily install output. FOD buildings receive towel dispensers only (tissue not in scope at this time).
meta.scopeNote: Confirmed program scope is ~12,054 dispensers (FOD towel-only). The building dataset below reflects ~10,586 GIS-mapped units; counts are reconciled as departments finalize FOD/orders.

departments.name: Facilities Operations & Development
departments.note: Towel dispensers ONLY. Tissue (toilet paper) is NOT in scope at this time. No tissue may be installed in any FOD building without a written change order.

departments.name: Athletics
departments.note: Confirmed 7/29/25; bumped for missing buildings (plan basis 550 manual towel / 1,300 quad tissue). Ohio Stadium is the anchor at ~1,023 units.

departments.name: Business Advancement
departments.note: Includes attic stock. Schottenstein Center is the largest BA building. Confirmed 8/4/25.

departments.name: Student Life
departments.note: Most complex department — 60+ buildings, residential towers with access-hour restrictions. Confirmed 4/14. NE residential towers first (Jones/Drackett/Taylor/Houston).

departments.name: Dining Services
departments.note: 38 confirmed locations, swept opportunistically while crews are in co-located buildings. Confirmed 7/29/25.

quadrants.label: Southeast — S. of Lane / E. of 315
quadrants.rationale: Highest density; largest buildings; central academic core.

quadrants.label: Northeast — N. of Lane / E. of 315
quadrants.rationale: Science/research cluster; tight; natural SE continuation.

quadrants.label: Southwest — S. of Lane / W. of 315
quadrants.rationale: Kinnear/Kenny Rd corridor; research & specialty buildings; vehicle required.

quadrants.label: Northwest — N. of Lane / W. of 315
quadrants.rationale: Waterman Farm area; low density; mop-up last.

phases.name: FOD — All Quadrants (Towel Only)
phases.seq: SE → NE → SW → NW (routing follows density). Tissue NOT in scope.

phases.name: Athletics + Business Advancement
phases.seq: Deploy in parallel with Phase 1 against the SE/NE footprint. Lead ATH with Ohio Stadium (~1,023).

phases.name: Student Life (NE residential first)
phases.seq: Residential towers — high count per building, access-hour restricted. NE first (Jones Tower = 489 tissue alone).

phases.name: Student Life Tail + Dining Services
phases.seq: DS (38 locations) swept opportunistically in already-visited buildings. Smallest crew deployment.

crewModel.base: 3 crew members per team · base case 150 dispensers/team/day

oldDispenser.title: OSU Custodial Removes
oldDispenser.detail: Best case. AA installs only; OSU custodial handles removal. Recommended.

oldDispenser.title: On-Site Dumpster Disposal
oldDispenser.detail: Crews dispose on-site via dumpsters per building/zone. Cargo vans sufficient.

oldDispenser.title: Return to Central Location
oldDispenser.detail: Requires box trucks. Adds 30–40% transit time. Not preferred.

logistics.deliveryTo: AA Installation office — 1770 Orleans St., Mandeville, LA 70448
staging: Dedicated on-campus staging location must be confirmed before Day 1.
New dispensers pre-sorted by building/zone the evening before each deployment day.
FOD stages towel dispensers only — no tissue staged for FOD buildings.
Cover-plate inventory confirmed before staging — tiled-surface survey needed.
Joint inventory check (AA Installation + Fastenal/OSU) required before first crew deploys.
logistics.liaison: OSU campus liaison strongly recommended — golf-cart accessible, full work days per active crew zone. Reduces per-building wait from 15–20 min to near-zero.

questions.q: Confirm total dispenser count including ~830 unmatched buildings.
Is a pre-install campus survey required? Is the cost covered if yes?
Are new dispensers pre-kitted by building, or delivered in bulk by type?
Are cover plates required? Quantity, surface types, supplier?
Wall-mount hardware spec? Any drilling-prohibited locations?
FOD manual vs. auto towel split per building (needed for crew kitting).
Plan for old dispensers — Scenario A (custodial), B (dumpster), or C (return)?
Confirmed staging and receiving location on campus?
Dedicated OSU campus liaison per active crew zone?
Which buildings require physical keys, keycards, or escort?
Access-hour restrictions per building type?
Blackout dates — athletic events, commencement, residential move-in/out?
Confirmed install window — Spring Break or Summer Break?
Hard completion deadline and any penalty clause?
Labeled campus map with department boundary overlays?
Vendor onboarding — COI, W-9, compliance, vendor portal?
Confirm crew availability for the target install window.
Run lodging (Airbnb) quote for Columbus for target duration.
Vehicle logistics — AA Installation vans or local rental?
Reactor Building (0158) — include or exclude from scope? Requires Reactor Director clearance.
FOD tissue excluded (towel only). ATH=550/1,300. DS=38 locations/167 units. Total=12,054.

specialAccess.note: Excluded from standard FOD scheduling. Formal clearance from the OSU Reactor Director required before inclusion. Marked FEED LOCATION X.
Confirm escort protocol and BSL ratings before crew entry.
Per-building access windows, quiet hours, and custodial schedules must be confirmed before Phase 3 is finalized.
